name: Thiboloha Special School
alternateName: Thiboloha Special School for Learners with Special Educational Needs
description: A special needs school providing excellence in education for deaf, blind, autistic, and intellectually impaired learners for over 50 years.

alumni.description: Graduates working in universities, hospitals, courts, and various industries across South Africa

award: Recognition for Excellence in Special Needs Education

programOffered.name: Deaf Learners Program
programOffered.description: Comprehensive education using South African Sign Language (SASL) from preprimary through FET
programOffered.teaches: South African Sign Language, Technical Skills, National Curriculum

programOffered.name: Blind Learners Program
programOffered.description: Specialized education for visually impaired learners with Braille instruction and mobility training
programOffered.teaches: Braille, Mobility Training, Adaptive Technology, National Curriculum

programOffered.name: Autistic Learners Program
programOffered.description: Structured learning environment with individualized support for learners on the autism spectrum
programOffered.teaches: Social Skills, Communication, Sensory Integration, National Curriculum

programOffered.name: Intellectual Barriers Program
programOffered.description: Life skills, creative arts, and practical subjects for learners with intellectual disabilities
programOffered.teaches: Life Skills, Creative Arts, Hospitality Training, Practical Subjects

memberOf.name: South African Department of Basic Education
